name: dsh-ops-codex
description: Codex adapter for dsh-ops FastCtx file, search, and background tools on Windows.

interface.shortDescription: Fast local file, search, and background tools
interface.longDescription: Adapts the dsh-ops FastCtx runtime to Codex through a local stdio MCP server. File tools work without bash. Shell and background tools require an explicit opt-in and a bash executable.
defaultPrompt: Inspect these large files with dsh-ops.
Set up the dsh-ops Codex runtime.
